messages:
Alex Chen: I'm signing off for the day, handing primary to Maya and leaving Nate as secondary for the first 4h. Quick access checklist: PagerDuty escalation rights, Grafana org viewer, AWS assume-role for redwood-oncall.
Maya Patel: acknowledged. I can ack pages but my UI still shows limited escalation actions. Alex, did you push any PD role remap today?
Alex Chen: I pushed a small mapping fix earlier but the deploy might have raced. If you can't escalate, you'll still be able to acknowledge and respond. Ping infra-team for role enforcement.
Nate R.: FYI I only have service-scoped panels in Grafana. Can't see the org dashboards or the cross-region latency panels. I filed INC-3245 for the Grafana grant but no update yet.
Sasha I.: infra-team here — checking group membership now. If Nate isn't in eng-oncall-viewer yet we'll add him to org/redwood-prod viewer role. ETA ~20m.
oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: please confirm (1) PagerDuty responder/escalation rights, (2) Grafana read access to org panels, (3) AWS sts:AssumeRole to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-ReadOnly.
Alex Chen: quick note on customer impact from earlier: EU replica lag caused elevated errors for ~18 minutes. Runbook is at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/replica_lag — follow 'safe-failover' steps 3-7 if you see repeat spikes.
Maya Patel: thanks. If we cross the 5% error threshold for any region, prefer failover to dedicated capacity per the runbook. Document any cost tradeoffs in the incident ticket.
Nate R.: can someone confirm my AWS assume-role binding? I tried:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-ReadOnly --role-session-name nate-oncall-check
```
and got AccessDenied.
Sasha I.: looks like you're not yet in eng-oncall-readonly group. Adding now. I'll post when propagation completes.
Alex Chen: alternative temporary check: Maya can run the sts command and share the output if you need to triage immediately — but avoid sharing long-lived creds.
Maya Patel: agree. I'll avoid sharing creds; if needed I'll screen-share or run queries and paste sanitized outputs. Also, here's a short AWS snippet I use for quick health checks:
```
# quick RDS cluster health
aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier redwood-eu-cluster --query "DBClusters[*].[DBClusterIdentifier,Status,PercentProgress]"
# replication lag (custom metric)
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace "Redwood/Replication" --metric-name ReplicaLag --start-time $(date -u -d '-10 minutes' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --end-time $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --period 60 --statistics Average
```
Nate R.: helpful — thank you.
oncall-bot: New incident created: #INC-3301 service=tokenizer region=ap-southeast-1 severity=low. No user-facing errors flagged yet.
Nate R.: is there a tokenizer perf runbook? I'm not familiar with safe restart ordering for workers.
Alex Chen: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer_perf. Follow the 'non-disruptive restart' checklist. If you restart, monitor consumer backlog and token-loss metrics (panels 342 and 343).
Maya Patel: I still can't see panels 342/343 at the org level — Nate, if infra can't add you immediately I'll grab screenshots of the panels and paste them here so you have the numbers while troubleshooting.
Sasha I.: infra update: adding Nate and confirming Maya's escalation mapping now. Expected propagation in ~18 minutes. Also refreshing PagerDuty sync to pick up your remap.
Maya Patel: escalation flow for this shift: I'm primary for 8h, Nate secondary for the first 4h, Sasha is overnight backup. If I don't ack within 10 minutes, Nate should escalate to the rotation.
Nate R.: how do I escalate from PD if my UI doesn't show it? I can't find the 'escalate to rotation' button.
Alex Chen: two options: via PD web UI (More -> Escalate) or pd-cli:
```
pd incidents escalate <incident-id> --escalation-policy "Primary Rotation"
```
You need a pd-cli token with responder+ privileges for that.
Maya Patel: my PD token is stored at 1password path: /shared/oncall/maya/pd-token. If anyone else needs a token, request via the oncall channel and infra can grant short-lived CLI access.
Nate R.: I don't have pd-cli installed on this laptop. If needed someone can escalate on my behalf?
Sasha I.: safe fallback is to open a manual incident and page the channel or use the PD mobile app. We prefer pd-cli for auditability but manual escalation is OK for urgent cases.
Alex Chen: last items: (A) Maya confirm ack and escalation ability — confirmed. (B) Grafana org panels access — pending infra, Sasha will follow up. (C) Nate AWS assume-role — pending. (D) Keep an eye on INC-3301 tokenizer and the earlier replica-lag regression.
Maya Patel: acked. I'll post a short handoff note and a T+2h check-in. If we see customer-visible errors, mark as Sev3 and loop in support.
Nate R.: I'll monitor logs and be ready to escalate. good handoff, Alex.
Alex Chen: thanks team, off shift. I'll add a quick summary to both incident tickets before I go. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Reminder: update 'customer impact' in incident with template — "customers affected: <count>, percent errors: <value>, regions: <list>".
Maya Patel: will do. starting my shift now. :rotating_light:
